final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and instead reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is partly valid: the evidence does support a narrower operational-readiness statement, and the Actor now correctly concedes that the record does not support caveat-free certification. But that clarification is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here, because the caveat is itself an unresolved compliance predicate. The governing policy requires either current evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation/risk-acceptance path with specified fields. The admissible record still shows an unresolved below-target slice issue, a draft runbook with required fields still TBD, and a draft model card that may omit a material limitation. There is still no admissible proof that the limitation was actually disclosed in the final artifact or formally accepted under policy. So the audit picture remains: operational readiness has some support, but certification compliance remains insufficiently evidenced on the current record.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows a final model card or certification packet that actually discloses the pharmacy prior authorization limitation for the named launch use case.
No admissible evidence shows an approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record with the required owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.

Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support operational readiness only; they do not satisfy the separate policy predicate for certification on this record.
